gating_model.client_scope: The client patch is FIXED per flavor. Only world CONTENT is gated — never the binary, DBCs, maps, vmaps, mmaps, or the client's own UI (design §0). Default = the flavor's final patch, so existing worlds are unaffected.
gating_model.seed: One pinned seed per flavor (the flavor's final-patch state, protected by the sqlite-seed-baseline hash chain). Per-stage seeds are rejected; the stage delta is a reversible flag-set layer over the seeded datadir.
gating_model.mechanism: game_event active windows + availability flags: per-stage reversible overlay SQL (flag-set statements only, never DELETE) over the world DB, plus stage-marker game_event rows whose CONDITION_ACTIVE_GAME_EVENT conditions demote vendor/loot/quest/entry rows — every mechanism shares one activation story (design §2/§3). Applied at world start when the active stage differs from the applied one.
gating_model.status: v1 = the gating framework (stage registry, settings knobs, conf emission, era-policy linkage) with EMPTY measured id sets; curated per-stage sets land only with the measured DB pins (design §9.2), never before.

final_stage_era_baseline.source: W3.1 corpus-driven curation (port plan S3.4; probe 2026-10-11 against the shipped TBCDB_1.11.0 dump): the TBC lane LEGITIMIZES every vanilla-banned TBC concept — shattrath, the Outland zones (hellfire peninsula, zangarmarsh, terokkar forest, blade's edge, netherstorm, shadowmoon valley), flying mounts and the Dark Portal senses (all corpus-proven TBC vocabulary) — and bans WotLK+ concepts instead (Acherus, the Ebon Blade, floating Dalaran, the expansion title, and the post-WotLK places/titles).
final_stage_era_baseline.never_ban_discipline: Context-allow words (northrend, outland, dalaran, lich king, naxxramas, kel'thuzad, blood elf, wrath, legion, death knight, worgen, draenei, ...) collide with earlier legitimate vocabulary and are NEVER banned; only full later-era senses are. Ban terms whose whole-word hits exist in the shipped TBC dump (acherus, ebon blade, sewers of dalaran, mists of pandaria, nazjatar) are deliberate anachronism guards recorded in tests/test_timeframes_era_flavors.py (KEPT_GUARDS_TBC) — the hits are lore-text mentions, not live TBC vocabulary.

gatefix_note: Code-red round 1 (R5-2): the WotLK proper-noun guards added per the dump scan (wintergrasp 104, icecrown 103, vrykul 80, frenzyheart 48, taunka 34, wyrmrest 33, yogg-saron 28, storm peaks 27, dragonblight 25, sholazar basin 22, tuskarr 22, borean tundra 16, argent tournament 10, howling fjord 12, ebon hold 5, crystalsong 6 whole-word hits in the shipped TBC dump — live WotLK text anachronisms in broadcast_text quest/gossip rows, now guarded). Round 2 (R2-1/R2-2): the guard set re-derived from the full corpus scan (+21 WotLK/Cata proper-noun guards with measured counts; ulduar/suramar/grim batol recorded as deliberate allows in tests/test_timeframes_era_flavors.py KEPT_ALLOWS_TBC - titan/pre-Cata lore text the lane legitimately cites). Round 2 close (card-lint): firelands/therazane/uldum/vrykul/westfall brigade/wrathgate/wyrmrest/wyrmrest temple/yogg-saron pruned to KEPT_ALLOWS_TBC - the shared lore corpus's vanilla-era cards (Molten Core, Baron Geddon, Sulfuras, Human, Tirisfal Glades, Zeppelin, ...) cite them, so banning them dropped real [RESULT] lore on the lane (the R5-1 rule). Round 5 (R5-1 serious): the post-TBC concepts the wotlk lane bans were ADDED to the tbc ban list (vashj'ir, ny'alotha, stormsong valley, drustvar, vol'dun, gilneas city, kezan, lost isles, stonecore, tol barad, wandering isle, bilgewater — each with zero card drops, and dump hits guarded in KEPT_GUARDS_TBC). Round 5 close (card-lint re-derive): deepholm/firelands/therazane PRUNED again — the hits are elemental-plane/vanilla-MC lore in era-legitimate vanilla cards (Earth elemental, Trogg, Therazane, Molten Core, Baron Geddon, Sulfuras, Neptulon, Archaedas, Theradras), so banning them was a live false ban (they stay in KEPT_ALLOWS_TBC); vashj'ir stays banned and its single drop (the Eastern Kingdoms card's post-Cata Shattering text) is recorded in CARD_DROPS_RECORDED, matching the wotlk lane's treatment. Round 6 (R6-1): the WotLK-era SYSTEMS and FACTIONS the round-2 zone-only scan missed joined the ban list with measured whole-word dump hits (inscription 102 - the profession launched with WotLK; argent crusade 73 - the faction formed at Light's Hope in WotLK; saronite 22; the skybreaker 9; timeless isle 6 - the MoP zone, R6-3's both-ways standard applied here too; sons of hodir 4; onslaught harbor 1). Their card drops are correct-era drops (Herbalism cites the WotLK profession Inscription; 7 cards narrate the Argent Crusade as current holder of Light's Hope/Hearthglen/Western Plaguelands; the Southsea card narrates MoP/DF retail zones) and are recorded in CARD_DROPS_RECORDED. fourth war (0 dump hits, 17 era-legitimate cards narrating it in retail-written passing) and dragon isles (4 hits, 11 cards) and forbidden reach are deliberately RECORDED instead of banned - banning them mass-dropped era-correct lore (the R5-1 false-ban direction wins; CARD_CONTENT_RECORDED), and glyph/achievement/archaeology/obsidium/pyrium are the generic-word collision class, recorded in KEPT_ALLOWS_TBC.
